headlines.title: 光大证券：短期内市场或继续反弹 关注三条业绩主线
headlines.summary: 光大证券研报认为，短期内市场或继续反弹，关注三条业绩主线。近期海外股市，尤其是半导体板块逐步企稳回升，对A股科技板块企稳具有一定的正向作用。8月半年报密集披露期有望成为市场从估值消化切换至盈利驱动的拐点，财报季或将是下半年最好的配置窗口。配置上建议围绕三条业绩主线展开。首先是科技硬件（半导体/AI算力/存储），这是本轮业绩改善最强的方向；其次为涨价链（有色/化工/煤炭），直接受益于PPI回升，业绩兑现确定性高；第三条主线为出口制造（储能/电力设备/汽车），受益于全球制造业补库与供应链优势。此外，非银金融、医药/CRO（创新药出海）、军工（订单拐点）等方向

headlines.title_en: Everbright Securities: Market may continue to rebound in short term; focus on three earnings主线
headlines.summary_en: Everbright Securities research report believes the market may continue to rebound in the short term, focusing on three earnings-driven investment lines. Recent stabilization and recovery in overseas stock markets, especially the semiconductor sector, has had a positive effect on the stabilization of A-share technology stocks. The intensive disclosure period for half-year reports in August is expected to become the turning point for the market to shift from valuation digestion to earnings-driven growth, and the earnings reporting season may be the best allocation window for the second half of the year. Allocation recommendations are centered on three earnings-driven lines. First is tech hardware (semiconductors/AI computing power/storage), which is the strongest direction of earnings improvement in this cycle; second is the price-hike chain (nonferrous metals/chemicals/coal), which directly benefits from PPI recovery with high certainty of earnings delivery; the third line is export manufacturing (energy storage/power equipment/automobiles), benefiting from global manufacturing restocking and supply chain advantages. Additionally, sectors such as non-bank financials, pharmaceuticals/CRO (innovative drug overseas expansion), and defense (order inflection point) are also worth attention.

headlines.title_en: Beijing CSRC Bureau: Intensify efforts to serve new quality productive forces; continuously support high-quality development of Beijing capital market
headlines.summary_en: [Beijing CSRC Bureau: Intensify efforts to serve new quality productive forces, continue to support high-quality development of the capital market in the capital city] The Beijing CSRC Bureau held the 2026 Beijing regional sponsorship institution regulatory exchange meeting. The bureau's head conveyed the spirit of the CSRC's party building and regulatory work symposium, reported on the regional sponsorship supervision work, exchanged new ideas and concepts in sponsorship work, and put forward work requirements. A responsible person from the Securities Association of China provided guidance on how to further improve the quality of issuance sponsorship work and introduced the association's next steps for self-regulatory supervision. 22 sponsorship institutions' responsible persons attended the meeting, and some shared their experiences based on their own work.

headlines.summary_en: On August 7, Guizhou Tyre announced that it had recently received notice from its overseas wholly-owned subsidiary that it had cumulatively received returned tariffs and interest totaling $11,983,022.69 from U.S. Customs and Border Protection. headlines.summary_en: Guizhou Tyre announced that its overseas wholly-owned subsidiary NACTR has recently received tax refunds from U.S. Customs and Border Protection. As of now, NACTR has cumulatively received returned tariffs and interest totaling $11.983 million, equivalent to approximately RMB 81.3587 million. According to the relevant provisions of the Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, the above tax amounts are expected to be included in current period profit and loss for 2026, without involving adjustments to prior period profit and loss. (Jiuyan Gongshe)

headlines.summary: 当地时间8月7日，知名千亿级私募景林资产披露2026年二季度末最新美股持仓（13F）。二季度，景林资产清仓英伟达、META等热门科技股，大幅减持英特尔、网易、谷歌等标的；景林资产在二季度末的美股持仓市值从38.8亿美元大幅下降至21.9亿美元，降幅达43%。在大幅收缩多只原有持仓的同时，景林资产也对部分半导体产业链公司进行了布局，包括近期业绩超预期的美国光模块制造商AAOI（应用光电）。（中国证券报）

headlines.title_en: Greenwoods Asset Management significantly reduces holdings in popular tech stocks in Q2
headlines.summary_en: On August 7 local time, renowned private equity firm Greenwoods Asset Management disclosed its latest U.S. equity holdings (13F) as of the end of Q2 2026. During the quarter, Greenwoods fully exited popular tech stocks including Nvidia and Meta, and significantly trimmed positions in Intel, NetEase, Google, among others. Its U.S. equity holdings market value dropped sharply from $3.88 billion to $2.19 billion at quarter-end, a decline of 43%. While sharply reducing multiple existing holdings, Greenwoods also built positions in some semiconductor supply chain companies, including U.S. optical module maker Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI), which recently beat earnings expectations. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: IMF驻华首席代表：中国服务消费增长强劲，且“后劲十足”
headlines.summary: 国际货币基金组织(IMF)驻华首席代表马歇尔·米尔斯近日称，中国服务消费一直在强劲增长，IMF相信该领域仍有相当大的扩展空间，这也是随着经济体收入水平提高而出现的一种预期趋势。 米尔斯表示，IMF乐见中国政府将政策重点放在扩大内需上，尤其是消费和服务消费。 米尔斯认为，从经济总量看，中国服务业规模占比及服务消费水平增长潜力可观。未来，应加快推进已出台的服务业支持措施，包括降低服务业壁垒、建设全国统一大市场、营造公平竞争环境，这将释放新需求，而数字化与人工智能也有望进一步提升服务业生产率。（中新网）

headlines.title_en: IMF Chief Representative in China: China's service consumption growth is strong and 'has ample momentum'
headlines.summary_en: IMF Chief Representative in China Marshall Mills recently said China's services consumption has been growing strongly, and the IMF believes there is still considerable room for expansion in this area, which is an expected trend as economies' income levels rise. Mills said the IMF is pleased to see the Chinese government focus its policy emphasis on expanding domestic demand, especially consumption and services consumption. Mills believes that from the perspective of total economic volume, China's service industry share and services consumption level have considerable growth potential. Going forward, the already-introduced support measures for the service industry should be accelerated, including lowering service industry barriers, building a unified national market, and creating a fair competition environment, which will release new demand, while digitalization and artificial intelligence are also expected to further improve service industry productivity. (China News Service)

headlines.summary: 私募巨头景林资产的海外子公司景林资产管理香港有限公司（以下简称景林香港公司），8月7日晚间向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交了截至2026年二季度末的持仓报告（13F）。根据13F文件，截至2026年6月30日，景林香港公司二季度末在美股市场合计持仓总市值为21.86亿美元，较一季度末的38.78亿美元大幅下降43.64%。从调仓动向来看，二季度景林香港公司新买进了4只证券，加仓了1只证券，同时清仓了8只证券，减持了11只证券。其中，景林香港公司清仓了Meta、英伟达、亚马逊等股票，大幅减持谷歌母公司Alphabet、英特尔、网易等核心持仓。（中国基金报

headlines.title_en: Clearing out Nvidia and Meta! Top private equity giant's U.S. stock holdings revealed
headlines.summary_en: Greenwoods Asset Management's overseas subsidiary, Greenwoods Asset Management Hong Kong Limited (hereinafter referred to as Greenwoods Hong Kong), submitted its holdings report (13F) for the end of Q2 2026 to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on the evening of August 7. According to the 13F filing, as of June 30, 2026, Greenwoods Hong Kong's total market value of U.S. stock holdings at the end of Q2 was $2.186 billion, a sharp decline of 43.64% from $3.878 billion at the end of Q1. In terms of position adjustments, Greenwoods Hong Kong bought 4 new securities, added to 1 security, liquidated 8 securities, and reduced positions in 11 securities in Q2. Among these, Greenwoods Hong Kong liquidated positions in Meta, Nvidia, Amazon, and others, and significantly reduced core holdings including Alphabet, Intel, and NetEase. (China Fund News)

headlines.title: 联合国现场丨AI会让发展中国家弯道超车吗？
headlines.summary: 世界银行集团8月5日发布的《2026年世界发展报告——人工智能：发展新机遇》指出，在全球发展中经济体经济平均增速疲弱的背景下，人工智能有望成为推动经济增长和改善公共服务的重要动力，帮助一些发展中国家在未来十年取得原本可能需要上百年才能实现的发展成果。不过，报告同时警告，如果电力、网络、技能和制度等基础条件不足，人工智能也可能进一步扩大国家间发展差距，加剧国内不平等。这是世界银行首次全面评估人工智能对发展中国家发展的影响。报告认为，人工智能最大的价值并非取代劳动力，而是提高劳动生产率、改善公共服务，并帮助发展中国家加快发展步伐。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: UN Scene丨Can AI help developing countries leapfrog?
headlines.summary_en: The World Bank Group's report released on August 5, '2026 World Development Report - Artificial Intelligence: New Opportunities for Development,' points out that against the backdrop of weak average economic growth in global developing economies, AI is expected to become an important driver for promoting economic growth and improving public services, helping some developing countries achieve development outcomes in the next decade that might otherwise have taken a century. However, the report also warns that if basic conditions such as electricity, networks, skills, and institutions are insufficient, AI could further widen development gaps between countries and exacerbate domestic inequality. This is the World Bank's first comprehensive assessment of AI's impact on the development of developing countries. The report believes that AI's greatest value lies not in replacing labor, but in raising labor productivity, improving public services, and helping developing countries accelerate their pace of development. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 上海国投先导参与投资智微凌峰基金
headlines.summary: 近日，上海国投先导公示对上海智微凌峰创业投资合伙企业（有限合伙）的投资。该基金由智微资本担任管理人，目标规模30亿元。LP阵容汇聚中微公司、澜起科技等半导体龙头的旗下平台，工业X射线检测领域企业日联科技的子公司，以及地方国资平台，形成“产业资本+国有资本”的深度联合。智微凌峰基金以半导体设备、零部件、材料及先进封装等集成电路核心环节为主攻方向，重点挖掘“卡脖子”领域的“隐形冠军”。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Guotou Leading participates in investment in Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Shanghai Guotou Pilot disclosed its investment in Shanghai Zhiwei Lingfeng Venture Capital Partnership (Limited Partnership). The fund, managed by Zhiwei Capital, has a target size of 3 billion yuan. Its LP lineup brings together platforms under semiconductor leaders including AMEC and Montage Technology, a subsidiary of industrial X-ray inspection firm Nuctech, as well as local state-owned capital platforms, forming a deep alliance of 'industrial capital + state capital.' Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund focuses on core integrated circuit segments such as semiconductor equipment, components, materials, and advanced packaging, with an emphasis on uncovering 'hidden champions' in 'bottleneck' areas.

headlines.title: 禁止“抱团”抬价！东北明确新能源集中报价仅限同省同集团
headlines.summary: 据中国电力报，国家能源局东北监管局日前印发《东北区域集中式新能源发电企业集中报价工作实施方案（试行）》，对辽宁、吉林、黑龙江三省集中式风电、光伏发电企业的市场报价行为作出系统性规范。其中明确，原则上仅允许同一集团（同一母公司、同一控股股东、同一实际控制人等）内同一省的新能源发电企业进行集中报价，禁止跨集团、跨省集中报价。禁止具有竞争关系的经营者达成固定或变更商品关系的垄断协议。

headlines.title_en: Ban on 'grouped' price hikes! Northeast China clarifies centralized new-energy quotes limited to same province and same group
headlines.summary_en: According to China Electric Power News, the Northeast Regulatory Bureau of the National Energy Administration recently issued the 'Implementation Plan for Centralized Quoting by Concentrated New Energy Power Generation Enterprises in the Northeast Region (Trial),' systematically regulating market quoting behavior for concentrated wind and solar power generators in Liaoning, Jilin, and Heilongjiang provinces. It specifies that, in principle, only new energy power generation enterprises within the same group (same parent company, same controlling shareholder, same actual controller, etc.) in the same province are allowed to conduct centralized quoting, with cross-group and cross-province centralized quoting prohibited. Operators with competitive relationships are prohibited from reaching monopoly agreements that fix or change commodity relationships.
